title: Choice and Wellbeing Explorer
description: Students explain how everyday personal choices affect mental and emotional wellbeing by adjusting sliders for common daily choices and observing a simple wellbeing meter respond.
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education

learningObjectives: Students explain how everyday personal choices affect mental and emotional wellbeing by adjusting sliders for common daily choices and observing a simple wellbeing meter respond.

pedagogical.instructionalRationale: Supports a Understand-level objective through direct interaction rather than passive reading.
